title: Mogę zająć miejsce
sunoPrompt: Driving garage rock, 148 BPM, muscular live drums, gritty riff-led propulsion, tight syncopated bass, raw sung Polish vocal and a compact repeated refrain. Loud rehearsal-room energy and continuous forward motion. Clear natural Polish diction. Build most of the song around the repeated chorus.
